name: Maricopa Association of Governments Open Data
known_limitations: MAG datasets support regional context, not facility-level evidence. FTFN must select specific datasets, dates, geographies, and local authority records before drawing local-system conclusions.
automation_notes: Use regional boundaries, land use, projections, transportation, heat, and other datasets as context layers for the U.S. Southwest Chip Corridor dossier.
notes: Phase 50 source recheck selected MAG item c1990106ce3840d6af8bc476ca31c30e, Projections of Population, Housing, & Employment for Maricopa and Pinal Counties, AZ, 2023. ArcGIS service metadata supports query/extract review of MPA, RAZ, and TAZ layers; do not infer chip-corridor readiness from the dataset alone.
